Follow-through has no random-entry baseline computed here; +1%/-1% first-touch on a 4h horizon is biased by clock size (5m bars carry a much smaller trigger move), so cross-clock comparison is not like-for-like
Breakouts across 25 coins are ~2.7 effective bets, so n is overstated and events cluster in time
14d window includes the strong advance, which dominates 14d stats; regime label reflects the last 3-7d
